title: Kaitou Saint Tail
native_title: 怪盗セイント・テール
overview:
You get to experience both Meimi's life at the academy and Saint Tail's adventures!!

Based on the anime, this adventure game stars Meimi Haneoka, an ordinary middle school girl by day and the phantom thief Saint Tail by night, who steals back ill-gotten treasures and returns them to their rightful owners - all while her classmate Asuka Jr., a detective's son, vows to catch her.

Explore the town and school from an overhead view and talk to the people around you to open up story episodes. School lessons take the form of minigames.

- 1-2 players

芽美ちゃんの学院生活とセイント・テールの冒険が両方体験できちゃうのだ！！
